definitions.gloss: being left out; being excluded; being kept out of the loop
definitions.explanation: An idiomatic expression meaning to be excluded from a group, discussion, or decision. Literally 'outside the mosquito net' — everyone inside is protected and included, while the person outside is not.

examples.japanese: {蚊帳|かや}の{外|そと}に{置|お}かれる。
{会議|かいぎ}の{決定|けってい}から{蚊帳|かや}の{外|そと}にされた。
examples.english: I was excluded from the meeting's decisions.

examples.japanese: {大事|だいじ}な{話|はなし}をするときに{蚊帳|かや}の{外|そと}に{置|お}かれるのは{悲|かな}しい。
examples.english: It's sad to be left out when important discussions are taking place.

notes: A {蚊帳|かや} is a traditional mosquito net hung over a sleeping area. Being outside it means being unprotected and excluded. Most commonly used with {置|お}かれる (to be placed/put): {蚊帳|かや}の{外|そと}に{置|お}かれる. Also seen in news contexts when a country or organization is excluded from negotiations or decisions.
